svg.title: How to calculate housing subscription points: the order for separately counting the no-homeownership period, dependents, and account tenure
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to calculate housing subscription points: the order
for separately counting the no-homeownership period,
dependents, and account tenure
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-11
Check the maximum scores for the three
categories
According to the points-system criteria in the
appendix, the no-homeownership period is worth
32 points, the number of dependents 35 points…
No-homeownership period: count from
the notice date
The no-homeownership period is based on the
period during which all household members have
owned no home as of the date of the resident…
Number of dependents: exclude the
applicant
Dependents are the people who meet the criteria,
such as a spouse, home-free direct ascendants,
and unmarried children.
Housing subscription account tenure:
use the original opening date
Account tenure is determined by the subscription
period as of the date of the resident
recruitment notice.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
